adapter_policy: Controller mounts and checks Retry(total=0,connect=0,read=0,status=0,redirect=0,other=0) before claim/send
redirect_policy: allow_redirects=False;no extra POST or fallback upload
cross_process_policy: permanent execution.lock + fsynced O_EXCL dispatch.claim and immutable fsynced events;never delete automatically
guarantee_scope: Client application/SDK/requests dispatches;cannot prove intermediaries/server never internally replay network requests
